newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA AIRPORT H1 PASSENGER TURNOVER UP SIX PCT.
newsitem.headline: RIGA AIRPORT H1 PASSENGER TURNOVER UP SIX PCT.

text.p: The Riga airport said on Wednesday that its first half passenger turnover rose by six percent on a year-on-year basis to 242,458 and cargo throughput remained nearly unchanged at 1,948 tonnes.
"The airport passenger turnover has grown by six percent in the first six months of the year," Viesturs Veinbergs, the aiirport's board vice-president, told Reuters.
"Provided nothing unexpected happens, it will reach 500,000 for all of 1997," he added.
The Riga airport cargo turnover has remained virtually unchanged for the third consecutive year.
"Riga registered 1,948 tonnes in the half-year versus the same period in 1996 with 1,952 tonnes," the airport's commercial manager, Jahnis Celminsh, said.
The national carrier AirBaltic, co-owned by Scandinavia's SAS, made up 25 percent of Riga airport passenger turnover.
"AirBaltic registered a 46 percent increase to 62,500 passengers during the half-year of 1997 against around 43,000 in the corresponding period of 1996," Veinbergs said.
SAS registered turnover in Riga of 36,000 passengers in the half-year, a drop of 12 percent compared to the first six months of 1996.
